playMode.fixture: Installed MRUK OtherRoom02_RecRoom, Editor Play Mode
relevantChecks: The gameplay Canvas has one registered SDK ray surface and one SDK poke surface. Both SDK hand branches include a poke interactor, and the physical poke surface covers the menu row.

Both authored Meta hand-ray prefabs selected their intended recovery row once using synthetic system aim and index pinch with the palm pointing upward. Both targets were under 30 degrees above a chest-height hand. A pinch held across a page change triggered no new action.
The right simulated ray opened Settings and the left ray selected Back through independent trigger presses.
Water showed the moving walls for 3.49 s after entry at 1.50 m eye height, before impact.
Lava showed the moving walls for 3.37 s after entry at 2.20 m eye height, before impact.
Injected MRUK NoScenePermission. The blocked board showed App permissions and Try again. Retry loaded the fixture and restored Welcome.
Injected MRUK NoRoomsFound. The blocked board showed Space Setup and Check again. Retry loaded the fixture and restored Welcome.
Withheld the real MRUK fixture's floor outline beyond the localization timeout. The game kept the board hidden, then fitted the restored scan and opened Welcome without a rescan or button press.
After an empty room query, a late MRUK RoomCreated event, putting on the headset, and positional tracking acquisition each restored Welcome independently. No menu press or rescan was used.

installedOnQuest.scope: Normal standalone APK launched on the physical headset unattended. No result is claimed about room appearance, menu selection or comfort.
